quiz.q: Which part of `GET /products/42?currency=usd` is the query string?
quiz.explain: Everything after `?` is the query string: optional extra options for the request.
201 Created is returned after a POST creates something new.

quiz.q: A logged-in user tries to open an admin-only page. Which status?
quiz.explain: 403 Forbidden: we know who you are, you're not allowed. 401 means we don't know who you are.

quiz.q: Why store a price as 1299 instead of 12.99?
options: Whole numbers of cents avoid floating-point rounding errors with money
quiz.explain: 0.1 + 0.2 is not exactly 0.3 in floating point. Counting cents as integers keeps money exact.

flashcards.front: Five parts of an HTTP request?
flashcards.back: Method, path (+ query string), version, headers, body.
401: not logged in (who are you?). 403: logged in but not allowed.
